name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: SEO & AEO Manager
summary: SEO and growth marketing manager with 4+ years of hands-on SEO experience and a decade-plus in B2B marketing and account management. Runs technical SEO audits, keyword strategy, and on-page schema implementation personally, ties performance to GA4 and CRM data, and reports results with a clear point of view on what to do next. Builds and uses AI tooling daily, including hands-on agent-building work with Claude, to run growth systems more efficiently, not just to keep up with client conversations about AI visibility and search.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword gap analyses, and competitor research using Screaming Frog for site-wide SEO data pulls, implementing fixes directly inside client CMS platforms.
Identify and implement schema and structured data as part of technical SEO audits, pulling full on-page schema implementation.

Optimized a client's Google Ads account - cut spam/low-quality leads and improved click-through quality - and diagnosed on-site CRO as the remaining conversion bottleneck, demonstrating full-funnel troubleshooting.

Architect and deploy autonomous, AI-driven marketing systems using tools including Claude and ChatGPT, translating stakeholders' business intent into structured AI agent workflows for lead scoring and outreach.
Grew client Meke Marketing's retainer from ~$12K/year to ~$24K/year (100% increase) within the first year of the engagement, by identifying and scoping expansion opportunities.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and strategic recommendations, backed by rigorous tracking across sales enablement, marketing, and operations.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Ran Google keyword research and search-term analysis to shape campaign targeting and content direction.
Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail verticals), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed campaign performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Led digital growth consultations aligning site architecture, inbound marketing, and SEO best practices to improve client traffic and conversion.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
